description: A row of checkbox-and-label day cells, seven in the real form and three here. chkSat is drawn 49 wide against lblSat at 144 - a pre-existing 17-pixel overlap the designer accepted, the way a checkbox's click area is often drawn a little wide. That overlap must not block the row from being rescued as a whole: lblSun's translation, growing past its own box, should still be given back to chkSun's drawn position rather than left standing on it, even though a different pair in the same row already touched at design time.
